findings.comment: Address 3759 Valley View Road is shown on multiple plan sheets but has not been verified against the City of Austin 911 Addressing system using Austin Build + Connect or by providing documentation from the 911 Addressing Division. Verification is required before plan approval.

Unit address schema showing Buildings 1-8 and units 101-806 is displayed on Sheet 29 (Addressing Plan), but no documentation of City of Austin 911 Addressing Division review and approval is provided in the site plan set or supplementary documents. Addressing Division approval documentation must be included before site plan or building permit approval.

applicableAreas: Multi-unit developments after Addressing Division approval
findings.comment: Sheet 29 shows an addressing plan with unit layout, but no separate approved PDF document named 'Addressed Layout' or 'Approved Addressed Floor Plan' meeting the standard naming convention has been attached to the site plan set. Additionally, no Excel spreadsheet with the unit schema table has been included. Both documents must be submitted and attached to the site plan set with proper naming convention.

No Excel spreadsheet containing the unit address schema table has been located in the submitted documents. The table must be submitted as an Excel file with the file naming convention 'SP-2025-0126C Valley View Townhomes_Address Unit Numbering Table' (or equivalent project identification), organizing all units by building and floor with proper row alignment and blank cells for non-existent floor/unit combinations.

Sheet 29 functions as an addressing layout, but it does not appear to be a separately submitted PDF document with the standard naming convention 'SP-2025-0126C Valley View Townhomes_Address Unit Numbering Plan' as required. A separate, properly named PDF addressing layout must be submitted.

Townhome units are assigned as interior unit numbers (101-806) at a shared address (3759 Valley View Road) using a Building# + Unit## schema. Per Addressing Standards Figure 4, attached townhome units with street-facing front door entrances must each be assigned a separate, independent main street address based on their entrance location along the street range. Townhome units must not be addressed using unit numbers at a shared address. Each townhome unit must receive its own primary street address from the Addressing Division.

The address 3759 Valley View Road, Austin, Texas 78704 appears on Sheets 1 and 9 title blocks, but verification that the correct 911-assigned street address appears on every sheet in the 39-sheet plan set has not been completed. The address must appear consistently on every sheet title block and client information block throughout the plan set.

Property address shown as 3759 Valley View Road on the site plan and application, but this address has not been verified as the official 911-assigned address through the City of Austin Addressing Division or confirmed against the 911 Addressing system records. Address consistency and official assignment status cannot be verified from the submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Multi-family residential projects submitting to Austin Energy
findings.comment: A 911 address verification form required as part of the Austin Energy service design submittal package per UCM 1.4.2.4.i has not been located in the electric review documentation. Austin Energy completeness review indicates only 'completeness check complete' with no reference to the address verification form submission. This form must be submitted with the Austin Energy design submittal package.

applicableAreas: Multi-family and mixed-use developments with individual utility meters
findings.comment: Electrical meter labeling details are not visible or documented in the available plan content. Verification that utility meters for the 39 townhome units are labeled with the 911-assigned unit identifiers (not directional or descriptive terms) cannot be completed. All utility meters must display permanent, weather-proof labels matching the 911-assigned unit address identifier with minimum 2-inch text height per UCM 1.9.1.7.

applicableAreas: Multi-unit developments or projects with private street names requiring Addressing Division approval
findings.comment: A required note stating that any post-approval changes to street names, building labels, unit configurations, unit arrangements, or access points after Addressing Division approval require a completely new addressing review prior to plan revision approval has not been located on the site plan sheets. This mandatory note must be included on the site plan set.
